title: Data Warehousing: BigQuery Architecture & Looker Studio — D4
purpose: Shows identities, trust boundaries, policy checks, and audit evidence.
routing_rationale: BigQuery's foundational superpower is the total decoupling of compute from storage: scale storage infinitely at commodity prices while scaling query compute dynamically from 0 to tens of thousands of slots on demand.

nodes.label: Capacitor Columnar Storage
nodes.detail: Stores data organized by column; prune partitions to scan only relevant date blocks.

nodes.label: Jupiter Petabit Network
nodes.detail: Connects thousands of compute slots to storage disks with zero network bottleneck.

nodes.label: Dremel Slot Worker Fleet
nodes.detail: Executes parallel tree aggregation; scales from 100 to 2,000 slots in seconds.

nodes.label: BigQuery BI Engine
nodes.detail: Sub-second SQL acceleration caching frequently queried analytical aggregations.

nodes.label: Looker Enterprise BI
nodes.detail: Governed business intelligence dashboards used by 5,000 corporate business analysts.

steps.title: Decoupled Storage & Compute Querying
steps.action: Looker submits SQL query; BI Engine serves from memory or falls back to Dremel slots.
steps.why_traversal: Delivers sub-second dashboard performance for 90% of business queries.

steps.title: Petabit Shuffling & Aggregation
steps.action: Jupiter streams columnar data from Colossus disks into Dremel slots in parallel.
steps.why_traversal: Scans petabytes of data in seconds without disk I/O bottlenecks.

scenarios.label: Unpartitioned Table Triggers $1,200 Query
scenarios.root_cause: Analyst ran 'SELECT *' on an unpartitioned 200TB table, scanning all columns and rows.
scenarios.diverted_path: Query scanned 200TB, incurring $1,250 on-demand cost for a single run.
scenarios.recovery: Enforce table partitioning on date and clustering on user_id, and configure maximum bytes billed limits.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.
